source_autosprite.prompt: 16f seamless LOOP cut-in idle for Maribo, chibi pink dolphin Ringpet, 3/4 front. Head STEADY/centered (no sway), only soft vertical breathing, gentle fin/armor motion, slight weight shift. The single cyan TRIDENT stays SOLID, RIGID, FULLY VISIBLE every frame; the 3-prong head stays sharp and unobstructed. NO water spray, splash, sparkle, glint, crystal shimmer, glow or mist on the spear/tip; the trident never dissolves, blurs, or fades. Keep the full trident in frame. Match reference identity EXACTLY. Transparent bg, safe margins, no text/UI/crop. Frame16 loops to 1.

Grid (4x4/16f/2048cell/8192) and the 0.90 dismiss size-match are unchanged.
